en_title: Life Is Strange Developer Don't Nod Blasted by Union Employees Over 'Illegal' Management Practices as Possible Layoffs Loom
cn_title: Don't Nod遭工会员工指控违法
subtitle: 裁员阴影下的焦虑
opus_summary: Don't Nod工会员工指控管理层违法，警告公司面临无力偿债和裁员风险。声明称，若方案获政府机构批准，员工可能在11月25日收到解雇通知。

paragraphs.en: An October 27 statement from employees of Don't Nod, the developer best known for making the original Life is Strange games, warn that the company is in danger of insolvency and layoffs, and accused its management of "illegal" practices that have caused staff "uncertainty and anxiety."
paragraphs.cn: 以开发早期《奇异人生》系列游戏闻名的Don't Nod，其员工于10月27日发表声明，警告公司面临无力偿债和裁员风险，并指控管理层的「违法」做法让员工陷入「不安与焦虑」。

paragraphs.en: The damning statement comes from employees who are members of the French game industry union Le Syndicat des Travailleureuses du Jeu Vidéo, which revealed that Don’t Nod is currently under a safeguard to help protect itself from insolvency (meaning that the company wouldn’t be able to pay its debts).
paragraphs.cn: 发表这份严厉声明的员工均为法国游戏行业工会Le Syndicat des Travailleureuses du Jeu Vidéo的成员。工会透露，Don't Nod目前正处于保障程序之下，以避免陷入无力偿债的境地，也就是公司将无法偿还债务。

paragraphs.en: The statement claims employees were approached by management and given “several financial scenarios” that could happen in the near future, both of which “included redundancies," with the worst case forecasting the “liquidation of the company through 2026.”
paragraphs.cn: 声明称，管理层曾与员工接洽，介绍了近期可能出现的「几种财务情形」。其中两种情形「都包括裁员」，最坏的预测则是「公司在2026年内清算」。

paragraphs.en: The message states that “nearly all of the non-managerial jobs” were cut at Don’t Nod, which reportedly included all animators, character artists, concept artists, associate producers, and most environmental artists, sound designers, level designers, programmers, QA testers, HR and developers. Half of its game designers were also laid off, according to the statement.
paragraphs.cn: 声明表示，Don't Nod「几乎所有非管理岗位」都遭到裁撤。据称，被裁人员包括全部动画师、角色美术师、概念美术师、助理制作人，以及大部分环境美术师、音效设计师、关卡设计师、程序员、QA测试人员、人力资源人员和开发人员。声明还称，半数游戏设计师也遭到裁员。

paragraphs.en: “Management is extremely clearly going for heavily individualized targeting and hasn’t been shy about their intent to keep selected people in rather than jobs, which is illegal,” the union wrote.
paragraphs.cn: 工会写道：「管理层的做法非常明显，就是高度针对个人。他们毫不掩饰自己的意图：要留下的是选定的人，而不是岗位，这种做法是违法的。」

paragraphs.en: The statement goes on to claim that management is betting on outsourcing to take on the workload of these fired team members — a decision that the union feels is “out-of-touch.”
paragraphs.cn: 声明进一步指称，管理层寄望于通过外包来承接这些被裁团队成员的工作量。工会认为，这一决定「脱离实际」。

paragraphs.en: The letter then says Don't Nod employees have been “living on the edge, in uncertainty and anxiety” for the last two years, to the point where six workplace accidents occurred this year and an inquiry was recently launched into a “serious and immediate danger.” It also alleges that management “refused to let those who would be willing to leave earlier go through a voluntary leave plan,” saying they “do not care about the damage it deals to employees’ health.”
paragraphs.cn: 信中接着表示，过去两年，Don't Nod员工一直「处于崩溃边缘，生活在不安与焦虑之中」，情况已发展到今年发生六起工作场所事故，近期还就「严重且迫在眉睫的危险」启动了调查。信中还指控，管理层「拒绝让愿意提前离职的人通过自愿离职计划离开」，称管理层「不在乎这会对员工健康造成怎样的伤害」。

paragraphs.en: The statement ends on a striking note; a government agency that represents employees is set to make its ruling on November 3. After that, management will have 21 days to decide on a plan. If this plan is accepted by the government agency, it’s possible that employees could “get their firing letters on November 25.”
paragraphs.cn: 声明结尾透露了一条引人关注的信息：代表员工的政府机构将于11月3日作出裁定。此后，管理层将有21天时间敲定方案。如果方案获得该政府机构批准，员工可能会「在11月25日收到解雇通知」。

paragraphs.en: “If it were to be rejected however, management would have to go back to the drawing board and improvise because, as you might have gathered, planning for contingencies isn’t their forte,” the letter concludes.
paragraphs.cn: 信件最后写道：「不过，如果方案遭到否决，管理层就得推倒重来，临场应对。因为你可能也看出来了，为突发情况预作打算并不是他们的强项。」

paragraphs.en: This is the latest news to surface regarding Don’t Nod’s dire financial straits after it was warned by auditors in a financial report that it could run out of cash as early as November. Its latest game, Aphelion , was released earlier this year to middling reviews, and given this recent union tell-all, its next project could be in peril.
paragraphs.cn: 这是Don't Nod严峻财务困境的最新消息。此前，审计师已在一份财务报告中警告，公司最早可能于11月耗尽现金。其最新游戏《Aphelion》于今年早些时候发售，评价平平。而从工会此次披露的情况来看，公司的下一个项目可能也岌岌可危。
